action_items.file: altline/depth.py TREE clavicle/half_hip_width/trunk; solver chest facing
action_items.change: Clavicle depth from the length formula turns the shoulder line when the shoulder landmark moves medially/upwards (arm raised, hands to face). Do not rebuild clavicle depth from length (shoulder landmarks are not a rigid segment end); take shoulder-line yaw from the hip line plus a bounded spine twist, or from the tracker (v1 behaviour).
action_items.fail: > 15 deg in any clip without a trunk turn.

action_items.change: L = max(rest projection, 98th percentile of the projection over the clip) is wrong under real (not weak) perspective: a limb moved toward the camera is magnified, so the p98 is 10-25 % longer than the true length. Every other frame, including the rest pose, then gets sqrt(L^2-d^2) of invented depth. Take L from the rest projection only (rest limbs are in-plane by the baseline definition) and either model perspective (scale each joint's image offset by its depth; focal length from the actor height in pixels, iterate 2-3 times) or cap L at the rest projection x 1.03. Add a test: a planar rest pose plus one limb swung toward a perspective camera must give 0 deg out-of-plane at rest.
action_items.expected: rest out-of-plane of every limb segment < 5 deg (depth_rebuild_diagnostics); hinge_bias_deg back to <= 35 deg in all clips; df1e/619b standing shin vertical in the side view.
action_items.fail: any rest segment still > 10 deg out of plane, or hinge bias > 40 deg.

action_items.change: The sign of each segment's depth is taken from the tracker per frame. When the tracker depth crosses zero the rebuilt depth jumps by 2*sqrt(L^2-d^2): up to 71 cm in one frame. Make the sign temporal: keep the previous frame's sign unless the opposite sign is supported for >= 3 frames (or solve the sign sequence by dynamic programming minimising depth jumps + joint-limit violations: knee/elbow cannot bend backwards, ankle behind the knee while the thigh points forward-up is a fold). Only then filter.
action_items.expected: no rebuilt depth jump > 10 cm/frame on any segment; df1e knee flex in the hold < 25 deg and ankle in front of the hip; 0663 f27-33 / 061c f79 / 0663 neck f57 jumps gone.
action_items.fail: df1e still folds the leg in the hold.

action_items.change: Frames above the 3000 deg/s^2 gate fell 311 -> 184 over the 8 clips, but the filter-only ablation (depth rebuild off) gives 86, and several peaks are higher than v1 (0663 forearm_r 39663 vs 20776, df1e foot_l 27296 vs 11852, 690b forearm_l 9110 vs 5262, 619b forearm_r 7554 vs 3150). The depth rebuild injects them (sign flips, entry into the length zone). Fix B1/B2 first, then re-measure; keep the filter (it does not lag).
action_items.expected: total frames above gate <= 90 over the 8 clips, no peak above v1's.

action_items.change: Child re-expression works (061c forearm_r twist error p95 25.2 -> 0.2 deg). Remaining: hand_r twist error p95 13.8 (v1 19.1) in 061c; df1e shin_l twist up to -42 deg is still hard-clamped to -30 in 55 frames (flex > 20, so no transfer) and foot_l is off its target by up to 30 deg (v1 40). Hard clamps still jolt (not addressed).
action_items.expected: hand_r twist p95 < 5; foot_l fk-vs-target < 10 deg.

action_items.change: The A2 formula is fixed (fade to 0 at 2*bias), but the bias is now measured on the rebuilt rest pose, where false depth bends the limbs: elbow_r 61.6 (061c), elbow_l 51.5 (690b), knee_r 39.4 (619b), knee_l 40.1 (df1e). Any real bend below the bias is erased and bends up to 2*bias are doubled (slope 2, noise doubled). After B1, cap the bias at ~30 deg and log a warning when the rest bend is larger.
